title: Create blue star anime themed OTT platform logo

requirements.summary: Generate a logo for an OTT streaming platform featuring a star design with anime-style aesthetics in blue color scheme
acceptanceCriteria: Logo features a prominent star element
Logo is suitable for an OTT/streaming platform brand
Image is generated and stored in frontend/public/assets/generated

file_operations.description: Generated blue star-shaped logo with anime aesthetic for OTT streaming platform. This image will be created by the image generation system with vibrant blue gradients, dynamic star design with sharp points, and modern eye-catching style suitable for digital branding.

requirements.summary: Display the generated OTT logo prominently in the application interface
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is rendered as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated
Logo is visible and properly sized in the UI
Logo maintains quality and clarity at display size

file_operations.description: Add the generated OTT logo to the main application interface. Reference the static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/ott-logo.dim_512x512.png and display it prominently with appropriate sizing to maintain quality and clarity. Ensure the logo is visible and serves as the primary branding element.

requirements.summary: Implement a creative visual theme with cohesive colors, typography, and layout that complements the anime-style blue star logo aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Visual design theme is consistent across all UI components
Color scheme harmonizes with the blue star logo
Typography choices support the anime/streaming platform aesthetic
Layout and interaction patterns feel cohesive with the overall design direction

file_operations.description: Update global styles to implement an anime-inspired visual theme that complements the blue star logo. Define a cohesive blue color palette using CSS custom properties that harmonizes with the logo's aesthetic. Select typography that supports the streaming platform and anime style.

Configure Tailwind theme to support the anime-style blue aesthetic. Extend the default theme with custom blue color variants that match the logo's color scheme, custom typography settings for anime/streaming platform aesthetic, and any necessary spacing or layout utilities to maintain visual cohesion.

Apply the anime-themed design system to the application layout. Use the defined color palette, typography, and spacing to create a cohesive visual experience that complements the blue star logo. Ensure layout and interaction patterns feel unified with the overall design direction.
